title: Relativization of symmetries on quandles
summary: This paper introduces relative versions of the inner automorphism group and the transvection group associated with surjective quandle homomorphisms. By using the relative inner automorphism group, we define a notion of connectedness for surjective homomorphisms. We characterize connected homomorphisms algebraically as quotient maps, and use the relative transvection group to establish a maximal connected--covering factorization for arbitrary surjections.
